title: 乾式配電變壓器設計
summary: 以樹脂絕緣、通風與非線性負載降額串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect resin insulation, ventilation and nonlinear-load derating through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 磁路與負載
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「磁路與負載」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop magnetics and load through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 磁路截面：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「磁路截面」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for core section.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「磁路截面」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。降低頻率但維持電壓會提高峰值磁通。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for core section, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare equal and unequal V/f cases. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。
steps.observationEn: Compare equal and unequal V/f cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「磁路截面」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping core section verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「磁路截面」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for core section; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 降低頻率但維持電壓會提高峰值磁通。
knowledge.textEn: Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare equal and unequal V/f cases. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設損失 2 kW、等效熱阻 0.025 K/W，穩態平均溫升 50 K。熱阻增加 20% 時為 60 K；集中參數模型不預測樹脂內局部熱點。
knowledge.textEn: Assume loss 2 kW and equivalent thermal resistance 0.025 K/W: steady mean rise is 50 K. A 20% resistance increase gives 60 K; this lumped model does not predict local resin hot spots.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「乾式配電變壓器設計」的「磁路截面：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「配電夜班：熱點追蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Core section: model and design” in “Dry-type distribution-transformer design”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Distribution Night Shift: Follow the Hotspot” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「磁路截面」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for core section?
options: 降低頻率但維持電壓會提高峰值磁通。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「磁路截面」的驗證。
只調整「磁路截面」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping core section verification.
Tuning the displayed core section result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 降低頻率但維持電壓會提高峰值磁通。 比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。
quiz.explanationEn: Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux. Compare equal and unequal V/f cases.

steps.title: 磁路截面：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「磁路截面」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for core section.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。 比較差異是否符合「降低頻率但維持電壓會提高峰值磁通。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare equal and unequal V/f cases. Compare the result against: Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較 V/f 相同與不同兩種情境。
steps.observationEn: Compare equal and unequal V/f cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「磁路截面」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping core section verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「磁路截面」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for core section; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
